purpose: The hub of the permanent Google Access ecosystem on this station. The bot owns the list of member skills, the contract they obey, the registry that makes the list executable, and the update loop that keeps each member honest. It owns no Google logic itself.

naming.reference: any existing skill name - read, not owned
naming.rule: Popy specified the mavis-skill-<name> format on 2026-10-28. It deliberately differs from the sibling bot mavis-session-extract-bot-skill, which uses mavis-session-<artifact>-skill: two bots, two contracts, and each verifier reads its own registry.

roles.hub: the bot itself - owns the list and the contract
roles.functional: owns one capability of the ecosystem
roles.meta: a process the bot needs to run (creation, verification, publication)
roles.reference: exists on the station and matters to the ecosystem, but is NOT owned by this bot - held to a weaker contract: the folder and its SKILL.md must exist, and the frontmatter name must not contradict the folder

contract.C1: The capability is live, not declared - a real API call or a real handshake answered with data
contract.C2: A refusal is reported as a refusal - REFUSED is never OK and never ERROR
contract.C3: The verifier is independent and can go red - exit 0 on the good state, exit 1 on a corrupted one
contract.C4: Nothing is silently lost - a gap is declared in the docs and in runs.md
contract.C5: The credential never leaves the volume - no secret in an image layer, a repo, a log, a chat or a handoff
contract.C6: The member records its run - runs.md gains an entry, with the measured numbers
contract.C7: The namespace stays separate - minimax and Hermes never share a container, a profile, a port or a credential
